clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Webwood Venom Sacs draw the attention of naturalists studying Teldrassil's growth. The sacs come from overgrown spiders, and their venom may show how the new World Tree has changed local wildlife.

Webwood spiders live around and within Shadowthread Cave, and they are cousins to a much smaller breed found elsewhere. Their sudden growth and predatory aggression worry night elf researchers. Naturalists such as Gilshalan Windwalker study the venom in their sacs, examining its strength and composition. They hope to learn how Teldrassil's rapid, unblessed growth is changing the creatures that live on its boughs.
